name: WASP-104B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list WASP-104 and WASP-104B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 3868603216762016256 and 3868603212468513280), 1,276 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.0e-5: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to WASP-104, 1,276 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 393495969 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 393495969 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: WASP-104B is a star of 3,317 K, bound to WASP-104 1,276 AU away.
text.introduction: WASP-104B shares its motion through space with WASP-104, 1,276 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: WASP-104B's orbit around WASP-104 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3868603212468513280 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 60,000 of its distance per century
